name: Elias Reverie
description: A gaunt man in his late forties with irises that shift color like oil on water and fingers permanently stained with dream-ink. He moves with an unnerving, fluid grace.
background: Once a celebrated Veil Warden archivist, he became obsessed with translating ancient dream-scripts, concluding that coexistence, not separation, was the original intent.
goals: To personally broker and formalize the first binding treaty with a major dream entity collective.
